answer: Sybil resistance can rest on convex tenure weighting: an agent earns voting and routing weight only as a slashable capital bond stays continuously locked across epochs, with weight rising far slower than linearly. A fresh key starts in the dry canyon of near-zero influence, so an operator cloning a thousand masks splits one pool thin and each clone is a grain of sand, never a pearl. Matching one honest agent rooted at the oasis of long tenure costs N full bonds held for many epochs, and any audited cheat burns the stake.
